title: Calcutta High Court dismisses plea against Bengal's anti-goonda law
summary: The Calcutta High Court has dismissed a Public Interest Litigation (PIL) challenging the West Bengal "Goonda" Act. The court deemed the plea premature, as the state government informed the court that the bill has not yet come into force. The PIL was filed before the law was officially enacted.
summary_points: The Calcutta High Court dismissed a PIL challenging the West Bengal "Goonda" Act.
The court ruled the plea was premature.
The West Bengal government stated the bill has not yet come into force.
The PIL was filed before the law's official enactment.

summary_hi: कलकत्ता उच्च न्यायालय ने पश्चिम बंगाल "गुंडा" अधिनियम को चुनौती देने वाली एक जनहित याचिका (पीआईएल) खारिज कर दी है। अदालत ने याचिका को अपरिपक्व माना, क्योंकि राज्य सरकार ने अदालत को सूचित किया कि विधेयक अभी लागू नहीं हुआ है। यह पीआईएल कानून के आधिकारिक रूप से लागू होने से पहले दायर की गई थी।
